---
title: "PCA from First Principles"
---

This project develops an understanding of principal component analysis
through mathematical explanations, worked examples, and reproducible
Python code.

## Approach

Each lecture will connect a concrete question to the mathematical
objects, operations, and assumptions needed to answer it. Accompanying
Python examples will make the reasoning executable and inspectable.

## Lectures

The first lecture is in preparation.

## Project status

The repository is in its initial setup stage. Lectures, Python
implementations, and automated checks will be added as the project develops.

## Source code

The source files and development history are available in the
[GitHub repository](https://github.com/hafizarslanamjad/pca-from-first-principles).
